issues.reason: The over-assertion half stands — an untensed strength-1.0 (Member sk_movement_1 trickle) claims a currently-holding state the sentence supersedes and directly collides with the flat gusher atom, while the surface past tense of 'started' wraps every categorical atom the clause yields; the other half does not, since the depictive rule expressly licenses a plain concurrent state emitted flat with no Result link and no tie to the event.

gaps_confirmed: predicative 'as'-NP after a verb ('started as a trickle') — the depictive rule's examples are bare adjectives/participles, and no section names the encoding for an as-NP secondary predicate
figurative predication (a movement as 'trickle' / 'gusher') — no metaphor policy, so the literal copular template emits kind-memberships that are false read literally
new_gaps: a state superseded within the same sentence (an initial state followed by a change-of-kind clause) has no marker that it no longer holds: the cessation bundle is restricted to the 'no longer / not anymore / used to' wordings, so a Past wrapper is the only available signal
repair_summary: Wrapped the initial-state atom as (Past (Member sk_movement_1 trickle)), the licensed past-copular wrapper for the past-tense 'started as' clause, so the superseded trickle state is no longer asserted as currently holding alongside the gusher atom; the change-of-kind half is left untouched, its flat result atom unwrapped exactly as the depot/museum template specifies.
notes: The compound kind, the intransitive change-of-state Patient on both events, and the full change-of-kind template (reified state, Experiencer, flat copular atom, Result, no spatial Goal) are all correct as parsed.
